race.title: Into Kildare Beginners Chase
race.verdict: ANZADAM is likely to have too much for fellow chasing debutants Eachtotheirown and Koktail Brut . Arcadian Emperor has experience on his side and may prove best of the rest. ANZADAM (FR) EACHTOTHEIROWN (IRE) KOKTAIL BRUT (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Anzadam (4/5), Eachtotheirown (7/2), Koktail Brut (5/1), Arcadian Emperor (8/1), Bertutea (16/1), Barley Lane (20/1), Parnell Street (33/1), Royal Soldier (100/1)
